title: TAI owner command exact-release orchestration
objective: Make the owner-only TAI command dispatch canonical Docker images, the existing exact-SHA full-stack release and the existing fail-closed TAI preflight for one immediately resolved current-main SHA.
boundaries: Command is accepted only on issue 3365
Comment author, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
All downstream workflows receive the same resolved current-main SHA
Bridge performs no deployment or production mutation itself
Canonical Docker, full-stack release and TAI preflight keep their own exact-SHA and confirmation gates
Any main movement causes downstream fail-closed rejection
